disabled.description: Indicates whether the field is disabled.

invalid.description: Indicates whether the field is invalid.

required.description: Indicates whether the field is required.

target.description: The target field item value the label should point to.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

ids.type: Partial<{ root: string; control: string; label: string; errorText: string; helperText: string; }>
ids.description: The ids of the elements. Useful for composition.

errors.description:
Errors from outside the field, such as a server response. They mark the field invalid
until the user changes the value, and show again when different errors are passed or the form is submitted.

validate.description:
Custom validation, run against the value and the native validity snapshot.
May return a promise; a newer validation run supersedes an in-flight one.

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.

state.description: The part's state from its machine, such as an item's `selected` and `highlighted`. `undefined` until it connects.
